posts.community: Safe Enterprises Retail Fixtures Limited: Positioning at the Intersection of India’s Retail Growth Story
posts.text: Very interesting business. Financials are too good to ignore. I have been reading on this company for some time now. My read is the management has been looking at it from a supply oriented lens so far (natural given that they are always catching up to meet the demand). They are only serving the organized retail business so far (Trent, apparently being the largest one). What i observe is that in tier 1, tier 2 cities the opportunity to serve standalone businesses is huge.
